 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. WWE is back with this week's edition of WWE Raw on Netflix.
 Monday's episode will take place at the Lenovo Center in Raleigh, North Carolina, and kick off at 8:00 PM ET. On tonight's show, John Cena returns to announce more invitees for the John Cena Classic on December 14, joining Cody Rhodes , Zilla Fatu and NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan. With Survivor Series: WarGames less than two weeks away, The Usos face The 946's Carmelo Hayes and Cruz Montana with the WarGames advantage on the line. Raquel Rodriguez also defends the Women's Intercontinental Championship against IYO SKY , who pinned her during a tag team match last week. Women's World Champion Liv Morgan , Stephanie Vaquer , Sol Ruca , Penta and Oba Femi are also advertised.
